Klasse DefensiveMoves

java.lang.Object
feu.agenten.shogo_seifert.AbstractMoves
moveCategories.DefensiveMoves
public class DefensiveMoves extends AbstractMoves
This class is a collection of defensive moves.

These moves can be used both reactively (the agent is under pressure) and preventively.

The class extends AbstractMoves and therefore has access to the shared game state and helper methods.

  • Methodendetails

    • collect

      public String collect(Map<Integer,Integer> budget)
      Collects all Fernies of owned nodes and places them on the strongest owned node.

      This move is useful in endgame situations, when the agent has only a few remaining spread on nodes.

      Parameter:
      budget - the budget of the Fernies currently available
      Gibt zurück:
      a move String representing the placement action

    • moveMax

      public String moveMax(Map<Integer,Integer> budget)
      Moves all Fernies of the owned node with the highest number of Fernies to the weakest visible enemy node. Usually, this move is used as a last move of a step to avoid harm as a result of an enemy attack on this node.
      Parameter:
      budget - the budget of the Fernies currently available
      Gibt zurück:
      a move String representing the shift action or an empty String if no enemy node was found or the enemy does not see this node

    • runAway

      public String runAway(Map<Integer,Integer> budget)
      Shifts the Fernies of the node with the highest number of Fernies to a node that has the best defensive potential.

      The best node to place is calculated by an helper method of GameUtils.Combat. If no good node was found, a fallback move is applied.

      Parameter:
      budget - the budget of the Fernies currently available
      Gibt zurück:
      a move String representing the shift action, a fallback move if no appropriate node was found or an empty String for edge cases
